chapter.subject: Science
chapter.chapter: Chapter 7 — Work, Energy, and Simple Machines

excerpts:
[INJSO 2009 — question paper]
1. Which one of the following expressions has the same units as power?
a) Force x distance
b) Work x time
¢) Force x acceleration
d) Force x velocity

[INJSO 2010 — question paper]
46. A trolley runs from point P to Q along a track, as shown in the figure. At point Q,
its potential energy is 50 kJ less than at point P. At point P, the trolley has kinetic energy
5 kJ. Between P and Q, the work done against friction is 10 kJ. What is the kinetic energy
at point Q?
a) 35 kJ b) 45 kJ c) 55 kJ d) 65 kJ

[INJSO 2012 — question paper]
1. A load is to be moved using a wheelbarrow. The total mass of the load and wheelbarrow is 60 kg.
The magnitude of gravitational acceleration is 10 ms 2 .
What is the work done if the handle is raised by 50 cm?
a) 35.0 J
b) 17.5 J
c) 175 J
d) 350 J

[INJSO 2012 — question paper]
45. The diagram shows a lift system in which the elevator (mass m 1 ) is partly counterbalanced by a
heavy weight (mass m 2 ).
At what rate does the motor provide energy to the system when the elevator is rising at a steady
speed v ? (g = acceleration of free fall) (consider the pulley as frictionless at the pivot)
a) (m 1 + m 2 )gv
b) ½ (m 1 + m 2 )gv
c) (m 1 m 2 )gv /(m 1 + m 2 )
d) (m 1 – m 2 )gv
